name: Tonight Cards
description: Prompts, duels, votes and silly rules.
howToPlay: Draw a card and do what it says.
Prompts and duels name players; votes ask the whole group.
Rule cards stay in play for a few cards.

howToPlay: Trekk et kort og gjør det som står.
Spørsmål og dueller nevner spillere; avstemninger spør hele gruppa.
